sentence: This project provides an automated cell processing system for developing advanced cellular therapies more efficiently.
This project tries to find activators of the Neuropeptide S receptor that may help treat alcohol use disorder.
This project builds a surgical navigation tool that uses computer vision and deep learning to track the liver during minimally invasive liver surgery.
This project continues a clinical site that evaluates undiagnosed disease, with a focus on virtual engagement and under-served populations.
This project provides flow cytometry and single cell tools to help study immune function in HIV infection.
This project studies how maternal immunity works during pregnancy and after vaccines against COVID-19, influenza and pertussis.
This project provides scientific and clinical oversight and statistical support so that the linked projects and cores can work together.
This project studies how the host defends itself against Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection.
This project studies how dormant yeast spores age and how gene expression changes during dormancy.
This project tries to find which host and bacterial pathways control tuberculosis disease, using models of alveolar macrophages.
This project measures heart rhythm signals and electrical activity in mouse atria and heart cells to understand atrial fibrillation.
This project builds blood tests for type 1 diabetes that other laboratories can easily recreate.
This project tests whether cells that build up with aging and bacteria-induced inflammation together cause periodontitis.
This project studies how public health insurance coverage of rapid genome sequencing affects the health and economic outcomes of infants in intensive care.
This project tests whether the RNA exosome complex keeps jumping genes quiet in B lymphocytes to protect genome integrity.
This project provides mouse models with edited genes, made using CRISPR in fertilized mouse eggs, for cancer researchers.
This project studies how climate, environmental and behavioral factors drive the spread of vector-borne disease.
This project studies the genes and traits of children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in Kenya and South Africa.
This project studies how a protein complex causes T cells to fail against cancer and uses that knowledge to engineer T cells that work longer.
This project builds methods that combine different types of brain imaging data to find brain imaging biomarkers.
